properties.description:
An idea that connects to nothing is now visible AS SUCH — and an idea somebody judged and found genuinely new is not mistaken for one.

THE THIRD LEG of `dec:idea-do-ideas-form-a-graph-or-only-a-list`, accepted by Anthony 2026-08-21 as option (b): detect always, invite at a boundary.

WHAT IT DOES. `review_relations` records what a node relates to, or that nothing does. It is ONE DOOR for both outcomes and REFUSES when given neither — because the two honest endings of an act of relating are an edge and the finding that there is nothing to draw, and only the first left a trace before this. `Decision.no_relation_note` is where the second ending lives. `unreviewed_ideas` is the detector: one AGGREGATE finding naming the proposed Decisions that carry neither.

⭐ WHY THE NOTE IS THE WHOLE DESIGN AND NOT A DETAIL. Without it, "nobody looked" and "somebody looked and there was honestly nothing" are the SAME STATE — both carry no relation. A detector built over that would report the people who did the work, which is worse than not detecting at all: the careful answer becomes indistinguishable from the missing one, and then both get complained about.

🛑 WHY IT IS AGGREGATE AND LOW-SEVERITY. Per-idea it would have fired 115 times on reflow2's own graph the day it shipped — every one of them correct, and the whole category filtered by the end of the week. One finding names the practice and lists the ideas.

🛑 AND WHY NOTHING SUGGESTS RELATIONS. A false neighbour is worse than a missing one: a missing edge leaves an idea hard to find, an invented one puts a wrong neighbour in front of every later reader, and anything that searches by neighbourhood repeats it forever. So the tool takes judgements and never offers them.

THE TIMING IS AN INSTRUCTION, NOT CODE, which is how `req:detecting-is-not-asking` was delivered the first time (`cap:the-loop-holds-the-invitation`, a timing rule in three served surfaces). Detection is unconditional; the count is put to the user at a boundary — a capture-session, an increment close — never at the moment of thinking. The brainstorm skill's rule against running detect-and-ask over brainstormed nodes stands unchanged.

📌 PROVENANCE OF THIS NODE, recorded because the repair is the interesting part: it was created by a PROBE. The dedup guard refused the real write, I re-sent a differently-worded call to read the near-matches it had truncated, and THAT call was not refused — so the node landed carrying the placeholder text "probe of the guard's near-matches only". The lesson was already written down from 2026-08-20 and repeated anyway. **A refusal message that does not say "a reworded retry will land" is a message that invites one.**
properties.name: An idea that connects to nothing is visible as such — and one somebody judged is not mistaken for it
